body: For suppliers, DO NOW should mean gap-map the published requirements—not buy a security package. The article’s scam/sales warning is operationally important: SCS is voluntary, no specific product is mandated, and OT is outside direct scope. So procurement teams should reject any vendor pitch built around ‘mandatory now.’ Spend becomes defensible only when a real control gap or customer contract requires it; otherwise you risk paying early for the wrong stack.
